question: The position of how many letters will remain unchanged if each of the letters in the word ‘VIRTUAL’ is arranged in English alphabetical order.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. One.

We need to arrange the letters of the given word alphabetically.

Given word: VIRTUAL

So, the number of letters whose position remains unchanged is one i.e. Position of I remains unchanged.

Hence, one is the correct answer.

solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात् एक है।

दिया गया शब्द: VIRTUAL

व्यवस्थित करने के बाद: AILRTUV

अतः, एक सही उत्तर है।
